title: Chest pain — possible heart attack warning signs
content: Call 999 immediately if you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away, pain that spreads to your left or right arm, or to your neck, jaw, stomach or back, or chest pain together with sweating, feeling sick, feeling lightheaded, or shortness of breath — this could be a heart attack and needs immediate treatment in hospital. See a GP for chest pain that comes and goes or that goes away quickly but you are still worried, to make sure it is nothing serious.
